item.title: Man carrying ammunition arrested near Trump National Golf Club before president's visit
item.description: Federal authorities arrested a man who appeared to be monitoring security-planning activities at Trump National Golf Club in LA County ahead of the president's Southern California visit.

item.title: State Department revokes visa of Brazil's ambassador to the U.S.
item.description: A senior State Department official said the visa would be reinstated immediately if Brazil grants diplomatic approval for President Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Perez.

item.title: U.S. has used nearly all its stockpile of long-range missiles, sources say
item.description: CBS News has previously reported that the U.S. has dwindling stockpiles of defensive interceptors and long-range missiles.

item.title: Rep. Max Miller says he's not stepping aside as House announces probe into abuse allegations
item.description: The House Ethics Committee says it is investigating the domestic abuse allegations against Republican Rep. Max Miller. CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns reports.

item.title: Rubio says there's been progress in talks between Iran and Oman on Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says there's been progress in talks between Iran and Oman on opening the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Breaking down the day's biggest primary races, including Stevens vs. El-Sayed in Michigan
item.description: It's primary day for five states, including Michigan, where Democrats are casting their ballots in a Senate race pitting Rep. Haley Stevens against Abdul El-Sayed. CBS News' Aaron Navarro and Anthony Salvanto report.

item.title: Progress made in Strait of Hormuz talks, Rubio says
item.description: The secretary of state said progress has been made in the Iran-Oman talks but that no final agreement has been reached, adding, "We're hoping that ‌will happen very ‌shortly."

item.title: Rep. Max Miller says he won't resign amid abuse allegations
item.description: Republican Rep. Max Miller of Ohio says he won't resign despite domestic abuse allegations, which he denies. In a CNN appearance on Tuesday, Miller compared his situation to past allegations against President Trump when he first ran for office in 2016. Political strategists Adam Brandon and Tricia McLaughlin join with analysis.

item.title: Wayward SpaceX rocket to slam into moon, leave 16-foot-deep crater
item.description: The impact will not be visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: What to know about cyclosporiasis' lethality after Michigan reports 2 deaths
item.description: Michigan health officials say cases of the intestinal infection cyclosporiasis are still climbing. CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder joins "The Takeout" with the latest on the parasitic outbreak.

item.title: Sen. Ted Cruz on future of AI, Texas Senate race and more
item.description: This week, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott announced he is freezing data center construction across the state until a comprehensive audit is completed. Texas Republican Sen. Ted Cruz joins "The Takeout" to discuss the pause and much more.

item.title: Pills from Lindsay Clancy's house examined on Day 6 of murder trial
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumed for a sixth day Tuesday with more testimony from prosecution witnesses and a focus on prescription pills.

item.title: SpaceX shows strong growth in its first earnings report since IPO
item.description: Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and AI provider reported quarterly revenue of $7.8 billion, topping Wall Street forecasts.

item.title: U.S. has used almost all of its long-range missiles, sources say
item.description: The U.S. has used nearly all its stockpile of long-range missiles amid the Iran war, sources tell CBS News. Matthew Kroenig, nonresident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, joins with analysis.

item.title: Inside the El-Sayed-Stevens Michigan Senate primary that could be barometer for the Democratic Party
item.description: Democratic voters in Michigan are casting ballots Tuesday in a hotly-contested Senate primary between progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed and moderate candidate Rep. Haley Stevens. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe, Aaron Navarro and Anthony Salvanto have the latest on the race.

item.title: SpaceX rocket expected to collide with moon, leave 16-foot crater
item.description: A SpaceX rocket weighing more than 8,000 pounds is set to hit the moon Wednesday in a rare man-made collision with the lunar surface. CBS News' Mark Strassmann has the story.

item.title: Law enforcement's actions in Nancy Guthrie case under scrutiny
item.description: The Wall Street Journal's Valerie Bauerlein joins CBS News to discuss her reporting on crucial missteps made by authorities in the days following the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: Michigan health official details effort to mitigate cyclosporiasis outbreak
item.description: More than 22,000 cases of the food-borne illness cyclosporiasis have been reported across 45 states. Adrienne Walling, prevention specialist for the Washtenaw County Health Department in Michigan, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: FBI not conducting civil rights probe into ICE shooting in Maine, sources say
item.description: The deadly encounter between an ICE officer and Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero on July 13 in Biddeford, Maine, is the latest in a growing string of clashes between civilians and ICE agents.

item.title: Chipotle removes jalapenos linked to Minnesota salmonella outbreak
item.description: The restaurant chain said it pulled the peppers and replaced them with product from another grower amid a food-poisoning probe.

item.title: Dow soars 900 points on strong corporate profits, hopes of Iran deal
item.description: Stocks notched new record highs on Tuesday as oil prices dipped and companies reported healthy profits.

item.title: Nazi ships, mammoth bones emerge as Danube River dries up
item.description: Water levels on the Danube River have dropped so low that dozens of World War II German battleships – and even the remains of an ancient woolly mammoth — are emerging into view.

item.title: More adult children live at home now than during the pandemic
item.description: One woman in her mid-30s said her $60,000 annual income wasn't enough to cover all her bills after a breakup, leading her to move back home.

item.title: Eaton Fire in Altadena sparked by SoCal Edison electric tower, probe finds
item.description: The department said an 18-month investigation concluded that electrical arcing on an out-of-service Southern California Edison tower was responsible.

item.title: Arson suspect in Spokane wildfire had prior manslaughter conviction
item.description: More than 700 buildings in the Spokane area have been destroyed and 400 more haven't been assessed, officials said as three fires burned in the area and an arrest was made in connection with one of them.

item.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Blanche's nomination for attorney general
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee voted along party lines to advance Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

item.title: 8/2/2026: Lourdes; The Improbable Tale of Ted Lasso; Birds of War
item.description: First, investigating medically unexplained cures. Then, a look behind the scenes of "Ted Lasso." And, birders flock here since guerrillas disarmed.

item.title: 7/12/2026: The Vatican's Orphans; Sealand; Christopher Nolan
item.description: First, a report on the Vatican's orphans. Then, welcome to Sealand, the world's smallest state. And, Christopher Nolan: The 60 Minutes interview.

item.title: 6/7/2026: Under Siege; Turning the Ship Around; The Dog Aging Project
item.description: First, a look at threats against U.S. judges under Trump. Then, collapse of U.S. shipbuilding poses national and economic security risks. And, a dog study may help pets and humans age well.

item.title: Kevorkian Lawyer Wins Primary
item.description: Geoffrey Fieger's Democrats' Choice In Michigan Governor's Race
